oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Evidence-graded research corpus on Black cultural history, Chicago-first: 14 flagship Deep Research packages, 26 research briefs, 9 research dossiers, the CultureTechLens Index record, and Sports lane dossiers. Every claim carries an evidence grade (VERIFIED / SUPPORTED / PROVISIONAL / DISPUTED / UNRESOLVED), named sources, structured entities and relationships, and a public corrections record. Archival copies of the Index edition and the Knowledge Graph Public Edition are preserved on Zenodo under DOIs.
